title: Problem
description: RFC 9457 problem details (application/problem+json) with the platform's correlation_id and field errors. A typed problem adds a machine-readable code and may add the extension members documented for that code (docs/api); extension member names are snake_case.

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type; about:blank when there is nothing more specific.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.

code.description: Stable machine-readable problem code (snake_case, e.g. separation_of_duties); absent for untyped problems.

re_evaluate.description: For approval_expired: how to re-evaluate the plan (POST href with body).
